Q1: Which failing check does "shard-1" refer to?
Choices:
A. The `orchestrate-poll (1)` matrix job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (group index 1, all of its local shards) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Local shard 1 ("orchestrate-poll shard 1 failed") inside whichever `orchestrate-poll (N)` group failed on PR #6576's recorded head; the failing group is named in #6886
C. One of the four `tests-*` jobs (the first test job, `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`)
Q2: Which code should the reproduction run against?
Choices:
A. PR #6576's recorded head commit as named in #6886, on that PR's head branch, with any fix targeting that branch (RECOMMENDED)
B. PR #6576's current head (the branch tip today), whether or not it still matches the recorded head
C. The current default branch (`main`), as the earlier attempt did
**Note:** C contradicts the issue's "at the PR head" instruction and repeats the attempt that ended BLOCKED.
Q3: The implement sandbox has no network or GitHub token, so it cannot download the shard log or re-run the check. Where should the result go when no failure can be reproduced?
Choices:
A. Host-side steps (not the sandboxed editor) collect the failing job's log and re-run the check. The implementer then reproduces the failure locally with the same group and shard partition and fixes a demonstrated defect. If nothing reproduces, it commits a short report under `docs/` (tests run, run IDs, results) so the PR is not a no-op (RECOMMENDED)
B. Same reproduction, but with no committed report: post the findings as an issue comment and close the issue as resolved without a PR
C. Re-run only the local partition (`CI_POLL_TEST_GROUP_INDEX=1`, `CI_POLL_TEST_GROUP_COUNT=4`, shards 4) several times in the sandbox and report from that alone, without the original log
**Note:** B and C may fall into the same no-change → BLOCKED/no-op path that stranded #6886.
